summary.name: Ivo
summary.one_liner: Ivo is an AI tool for legal teams that reviews contracts against playbooks and past agreements, and tracks them from intake through signature.
use_cases: Reviewing incoming contracts against a company playbook
Deciding which contract terms to accept, push back on, or fall back on
Applying redlines directly in Word or Google Docs
Comparing a draft against previously executed agreements
Tracking regulatory changes and their impact on contract positions
Querying a contract repository in plain language
Viewing an agreement with all its amendments in a timeline
summary.what_it_does: Ivo reviews contracts against a user's playbooks, historical contracts, and deal context such as contract value and urgency, and shows which terms to accept, push, or fall back on. It applies redlines inside Microsoft Word or Google Docs. It can turn templates and repository contracts into a playbook, and benchmark clauses against executed contracts by governing law, contract type, party role, and industry. It also tracks changes in the law and researches regulations to flag agreement terms that fall short. For contract repositories, it extracts data automatically from connected sources and lets users query it in plain English without manual tagging, and shows amendments in a timeline.
notable: Applies redlines directly in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
Queries contracts in plain English with no manual tagging or fields
Shows an agreement and its amendments in one timeline
Tracks changes in law and reports impact on negotiating positions
